body:
A really pleasant, relaxing, almost euphoric feeling washed over me ~30 minutes after ingesting the pills. I feel very good mentally and the physical relaxation is just adding to it. Not tired at all, but very very cozy and relaxed. I even feel relaxed lurching over my laptop.
Music enhancement is insane with this combo, however. I feel much more connected to the music than say Phenibut alone.
It's even more pronounced than Weed in terms of relaxation. Feels similar, however. I definitely don't feel 'high,' but it's a very pleasant and calming feeling. Highly recommend.
